evidence.note: Init records o.Branch into run.InitData.Branch (json 'branch,omitempty'), so legacy runs read as empty branch
abandonedRun takes branch and head from the init event only; later events reuse 'head' (all string-typed in event.go) so unmarshal never fails on them and cannot overwrite the init head
scanAbandonedRuns: InScope blocks, other-branch/orphaned go to elsewhere; dedupe keeps a blocking copy from being hidden by a same-id copy elsewhere and removes blocking ids from elsewhere
Classify fails closed on unknown scope; legacy runs cleared only on git's exit-1 'no' or a pruned commit, matching TestClassify cases
rebasing joins a relative --git-path to root, which is git's cwd, so a subdirectory root resolves correctly (checked: ../../.git/rebase-merge/head-name from internal/scope)
go test ./internal/scope/ ./internal/status/ passes at head ce80bb4; removed worktree-ownership helpers (enterableAncestor, canonical, bareMain) have no remaining callers in the shard's file

findings.note: Known (final-review list): TestClassify's legacy past-heads case uses the non-SHA 'h-past', so it exercises the pastHeads leg via a head reachable() would never ask git about; coverage gap only, behaviour verified by the real-repository test.
